reviews.title: Perfect Left Side PC Case
reviews.comment: Absolutely goated PC case. I picked this specifically because I wanted my PC on the left side of my desk, and this PC looks great! The fan hubs are also great even though I’m using daisy chained fans. Plenty of room in the back for cable management, and I was able to fit a high end custom water cooled build in it.
reviews.author: Austin

reviews.title: Amazing PC Case
reviews.comment: Purchased the case without fans since I had plans to have all matching fans for this build.  The case arrived in great shape ... Bequiet did great with providing plenty of protection for the case 👍. I had one small hiccup with one of the RGB headers that came with the case ... someone in production didn't give enough slack for one of the wires running from the RGB header and it pulled the connection off the header a little ... didn't break or compromise the performance of the lighting for the case. I even contacted Bequiet and explained the situation ... they didn't skip a beat with responding by sending me 4 extra RGB headers ( my kind of customer service!). The build quality of the case is SOLID. They also did a great job with the white paint for the case ... no missed spots and no imperfections 👍 This case has plenty of room for cable management, its super easy to take part to get easy access for installation. I purchased AsianHorse PC Fans for this build... Half the price of Lian Li's pc fans and they provide great lighting and airflow! ***The photos attached are from testing the RGB lighting for the case ... as well as making sure all the fan performed properly and there were no issues. **
reviews.author: Brendan Campo
